customer: Good morning, I hope this reaches the right person. I'm retired now and have been driving my old station wagon for years, mostly to the grocery store and my grandkids' place here in North Carolina, but last spring our street flooded during that big storm and water came up over the floorboards for a day or so. It dried out and runs fine as far as I can tell, so I was wondering whether you'd still consider buying it from me, or if that bit of water is going to be a problem?
agent: Thank you for writing and for being upfront about the flooding. Under our Flood-damaged cars policy, cars with flood damage, or with a flood brand on the title, count as branded, and we don't buy them, as explained in our Salvage and rebuilt titles article. Since water got into the cabin of your station wagon, please be sure to tell us about it if you request an offer.
